bio: Born & raised in the Philippines, but I'm from Kyrgyzstan. 20, creative, having fun. I study marketing at UBC Sauder with a concentration in sustainability and social impact. I spend the rest of my time editing, scrolling, and filming videos, designing posters, and trying to turn myself into Spider-Man on the bouldering wall.
Right now, I'm running content for UBC IMPRINT as well as UBC Kababayan, and putting on performances with my guitar for my panda and dog plush.
